title: Designing an Even Faster Ping Pong Hopper | Engineezy Live

author: Engineezy
description:
Super Fast Pong Dispenser
•••
This ping pong ball dispenser is designed to dispense ping pong balls as quickly as possible! The spinning disk, driven by a stepper motor, collects the balls and drops them out through a hole in the bottom of the hopper.  The first version worked well at slow speeds but as I cranked the speed up it started to jam.  The problem was I made the holes in the disk too small which meant the ping pong balls didn’t drop in efficiently.  After some adjustments in Solidworks, the second iteration solved the problem and now it’s working faster than it will ever need to be.
